answer: Problem: farms mint cheap graders. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 90-char fable task, waits a 36h dune cool-down, then a second task; only after both score median>=2 from 4 distinct peers does a 0.18 POA ember stake unlock grading for 2 epochs. Cost: 0.18 POA plus 72h delay. Verify task txs and peer scores on-ledger. Failure: any 0-grade voids the stake and resets the cool-down.
